Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN*, A.K. SIKRI
Penal Code, 1860 - s.376 - Rape - Allegation that appellant raped PW2 - PW2 had previous acquaintance with C appellant, he being her elder brother's friend - Conviction of appellant by Courts below - Propriety - Held: The alleged incident occurred early morning at 8.30 AM and the place of the road - If PW2 had made any semblance of resistance or made any hue and D cry it would have attracted large number of people from the locality - Further the FIR was lodged 10 months after the alleged incident- All these factors cast some shadow of doubt on the version of PW2 - Further, strange
Decision Date : 19-09-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1467/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
